items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Billy Kyle called me, and asked me did I want to do a show, a Broadway musical... So I went in that show

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, the pianist, Billy Kyle. He was rehearsing a show downtown by the name of "Alive and Kicking," I think, and they wanted a drummer, colored drummer supposed to be a swing drummer, because when you're in the pits, you have no reason to be flashy, like in a Broadway musical.
So I went in that show, and I played over 21 Broadway musicals. They really set me up. You know, I told you about that.
